text: Without this app I would not be as far with my website as I am now. It helps importing new and making updates to metaobjects in seconds. It is very fast and very effective. The team is also very responsive and willing to help you in any way!

Bulkflow worked perfectly for my needs, importing all my data perfectly and the support was top-notch. Andrew was on chat and responded quickly and expertly to every question which really made a tough and nerve-wracking job (messing with customer data can be really stressful!) go much smoother. Excellent work and will use them again when needed. Thanks :)
I imported close to 10000 products without a problem. Whenever I have a question i can simply open up a chat and get almost an instant reply ! This app is 10/10

Great app and excellent customer support! The BulkFlow team has been incredibly helpful, responsive, and patient throughout the process. Andrew was especially kind and went above and beyond to help us find solutions and make everything run smoothly. We really appreciate the team's willingness to listen, provide assistance, and make the overall experience as easy as possible. It's always a pleasure working with a team that genuinely cares about helping its customers. Highly recommend BulkFlow to other businesses looking for a reliable and helpful solution. Thank you so much to the BulkFlow team!

I recently migrated from Wordpress/Woocommerce to Shopify and Bulkflow was a great help in that! Easy and logical user interface, many many options and great online support that seems 24/7 available! Also, the new update function, where you can bulk update within the app (so no need to export and re-import) is a really super feature. Highly recommended!
Andrew did a brilliant job in sorting issues we had with importing sales history and dates for each sale, it wasn't and easy task, but we got there with his assistance. thankyou!

Initally the sync didn't go as I wanted it. I've contacted the team and the customer support was quick, efficient and friendly. The team did not care how long it will take, they were on it. It was nice to feel looked after. My problem was fixed and I'm happy with how things turned out.
This app has become an essential part of our store. Customer service is excellent! New functionality is coming along with it making it even better. Thank you!

Fantastic app for migrating historical orders to Shopify. The support team (Kendrick & Andrew) was incredible: super responsive, tested my file, and quickly solved my fulfillment tracking issues. Highly recommended!
Einfach und simple! So lassen sich die Artikeldaten leicht aktualisieren. Und der Support ist unfassbar hilfsbereit!!! Vielen Dank!!
This tool has some way to go. But it has the best customer support I have experienced. Thanks for the help!
Ich bin sehr zufrieden. Die Hilfe über den Chat ist schnell, verständlich und unkompliziert.
Amazing App, great service. 100% recommended.

Brilliant and affordable app. I only use it for stock updates from different suppliers and sheets in different configurations and so far all is working as expected. Support is near instant, concise and super helpful.
bien
Excellent features and customer service

Really solid app for bulk edits. I was stuck trying to bulk update and upload discounts, but support was super friendly and replied fast. They helped me fix everything quickly and saved me a ton of time. Very efficient tool — highly recommend.

Awesome app works perfectly we are able to sync our entire catalogue from google sheets to shopify with ease. The product mapping is easy to use plus can setup for metafields. Shoutout to the Amazing LIVE Support, Kendrick was fast to help me setup custom mapping fast. All going smooth glad i found this app def. Reccommend to anyone looking for Fast straight-forward way to get products uploaded or sync even exported vice versa all in one!

Moved across to Shopify from another platform and was n need of an app to import a large number of products and then run scheduled tasks to keep inventory levels etc upto date with supplier files. The app was easy to install and to use is very straightforward too. The level of support received is first class - always get an answer to any queries or questions. Sometimes a reply back within seconds of posting. Would totally recommend this app.

I am a board game publisher and I used Bulkflow to import customer shipping address info from Kickstarter to Shopify. The support (an actual person) was extremely responsive via chat. I didn't run into any problems after learning how it all works. If an entry failed to import into Shopify due to missing data Bulkflow clearly described the category of problem (missing phone, etc). I highly recommend Bulkflow!

Great alternative to the other. My favorite one, easy to use, exports and imports are flawless. Love the ability to export directly to Excel and not csv only like others. Allows me to edit very simple. Their development team is also taking feedbacks and suggestions and tries to implement them as well. 5 out of 5!

Amazing customer service. Happy with the app and it's capabilities. Easy to use and works efficiently. Price point is fair in a market where the amount of subscriptions adds up fast. Keep up the great work.

L'unico modo per poter importare i prodotti su shipify e che si avvicina a Wp all import di Woocommerce. Assistenza ottima anche in lingua Italiana, l'app è abbastanza intuitiva e se c'è qualche problema l'assistenza è pronta nella risposta. legge campi come, Tag, meta dati ecc.... Gli aggiornamenti stock non influiscono sui limiti mensili.
The team was super responsive and helpful. I did not experience such customer care on any app so far. 5/5 The app itself is intuitive and the guides are great. 5/5
Best app ever. Easy to use. Customer service is very fast and always available to assist you. They are very professional.
Support always online and super fast in order to help setting all the imports correctly. Very supportive and kind team. Deeply reccomended.
Bonne application. Le service client est très disponible, aidant et patient. Merci à vous

Liked it and it did 90% of the price update job. Problem areas: During update it activates draft products, although STATUS field is FALSE in the upload file. You need to remove them from update file. And whatever you do it leaves some products without updating and you need to go through all products to see which are so. No visible reason why they are left aside. If you have too many products that could be a problem. Thanks anyway.
Excellent app, very helpful.
Great app with great support
Super einfach installiert und den ersten Feed exportiert. Kontakt mit dem Support war auch hilfreich und schnell. Alles super.

well i am using this app for an almost 6 to 7 months since it has a web app vesion instead of updatig products directly on shopify, Right now its became one of the best app to updates contents in bulk, its very affodable, with almost 100% of Sucess rate, as compared to other apps also sales team very responding very quickly especially souly Currently every products at http://loosemoissanite.com/ was optimised as just because this app
Great App! Support team also very helpful!
Just been testing this for both import and export of CSV, after sausaging the files and it worked brilliantly. Having looked at a coupe of other apps, this one just worked.
